daily.intro: One shift. Eight souls. The same for everyone today.
daily.decree: Every rule you know is in force: weapon in hand, no wounds in the back, the feather, Freyja's whim and the sea.
daily.whim.leftHanded: Freyja's whim: the worthy left-handed are hers.
daily.whim.redHair: Freyja's whim: the worthy red-haired are hers.
daily.whim.amber: Freyja's whim: the worthy who wear amber are hers.
primer.decree: Your first shift: three souls and no sun, so take your time.
primer.whim.amber: Freyja's whim: the worthy who wear amber are hers.
primer.hint: New here? Take the two-minute primer first.
primer.title: Primer
primer.c1.look: A soul has reached your gate. Look them over: tap the hands.
primer.c1.chest: Now the chest. Wounds on the front mean they faced the fight.
primer.c1.rules: The Order of Judgment decides. Rules apply from the top, and the first one that fits wins. Read it now.
primer.c1.stamp: Fell in battle with a weapon in hand: Valhalla. Choose the VALHALLA stamp, then send.
primer.c2.words: Read what this one says. The dead lie to get into Valhalla.
primer.c2.flip: "Never turned my back"? Turn the body over.
primer.c2.compare: A wound in the back means they fled. Catch the lie: tap their claim, then the wound.
primer.c2.judge: Caught. You could question them (20 seconds of sun), but the body has already told you. The fled go to Hel: stamp HEL.
primer.c3.face: Look at the face. A mist at the lips is a hint, not proof.
primer.c3.feather: Use the feather to be sure. Tools cost sun: this one costs 10 seconds.
primer.c3.stamp: The feather stirs: this one still breathes. The living go back. Stamp RETURN.
primer.done.title: You're ready
primer.done.body: Two more rules wait in the Daily. Sea-foam on the lips means the sea took them: that's Rán. And each day Freyja names a whim; worthy souls who match it are hers, in Fólkvangr. In the Daily the sun runs, and every tool, question and wrong compare costs some of it.
ach.cleanSlate.title: Clean slate
ach.cleanSlate.text: Judge every soul in today's Daily rightly.
ach.nobodysHelp.title: Nobody's help
ach.nobodysHelp.text: Judge every soul in today's Daily rightly, with no hints and no assists.
ach.homeBeforeDark.title: Home before dark
ach.homeBeforeDark.text: Judge every soul in today's Daily rightly with half the sun still up, and no assists.
